summary: Stayed/avg-viewed split: when stayed% runs far below typical while avg % viewed runs above typical, the loss is at the first-frame swipe, not the body. Observed on 2 independent Glyph videos (Theft Parachute 58.1/91.5; D.B. Cooper 71.3/101.4).

~82% stayed has separated Glyph breakouts from non-breakouts in 6 finalized reads (2 above with pushes, 4 below without). Association only — causation unproven; debate-driven Mom Dilemma (74.8%) is a partial counterexample via a different engine.

Hidden-detail comment bait: roblxify ran 12+ pop-offs in ~19 days on riddle/hidden-detail formats (up to ~182x comment multiples); craftee_films is a second creator using comments-as-content. Comments hunting a hidden detail appear to feed distribution.
Mom Dilemma Oct 15 check-in (37,963 views / 35 comments) contradicts Oct 13 (66.7K / 1,237) and Oct 18 (~68K / ~1.2K) reads. Flagged unreliable in the DB; not deleted. Needs a fresh Studio re-verify.

Velocity clustering: once a niche creator pops twice, their next posts ride the wave (nepshublox 13+ hits in ~2.5 weeks; craftee_films ~18 pop-offs in 8 days incl. back-catalog compounding, '1,000,000 Steps' 106.8K→304.7K likes in 24h). Watch hot accounts' next 48h for steal-able formats.
